  PROBLEM: The decompose fixture dispatch does not pass the `e2e-smoke-test` tracking label, so a model-generated title that drops the smoke marker can prevent the poller from recognizing the fixture and silencing its alert.
  WHY: The gate warns at test-and-mark-stable.yml:5416 that "the smoke-test prefix is not guaranteed to survive," while its dispatch at test-and-mark-stable.yml:5411 passes only project_description.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:646-663 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The smoke-fixture detector can miss the decompose fixture when its generated tracking-issue title omits or changes the smoke marker, and the tracking issue has no `e2e-smoke-test` label fallback.
  WHY: The workflow says the smoke prefix is “not guaranteed to survive that rewrite” (`.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5413-5422`), and the orchestrator does not add the `e2e-smoke-test` label (`.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1085-1095`); the fixture can therefore be absent from `SMOKE_FIXTURE_TRACKING_NUMS` and its poller alerts can be sent.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:646-660 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The detector's two orchestrator-prefixed patterns require the literal "e2e orchestrate smoke" substring to survive in the LLM-derived `project_title`; if the title drops that prefix, the detector misses the decompose fixture.
  WHY: The stable-gate's own comment at `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5413-5422` explicitly states "the smoke-test prefix is not guaranteed to survive that rewrite" of `project_description` → `project_title`. The orchestrator does not apply the `e2e-smoke-test` label to tracking issues (the gate only uses that label on the PR side, never the orchestrator's tracking issue — confirmed by `grep e2e-smoke-test .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` showing the label is referenced only in PR-side / concurrency / job-name contexts, and orchestrate.yml:1087-1095 only adds `ai:orchestrator-tracking` (+ optional engine label)).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description's deliverable #2 — "smoke-fixture projects never page" — specifically motivated by the orchestrator decompose smoke fixture that paged in #7017 (release run 38010697715) and confirmed by the gate's own comment at `test-and-mark-stable.yml:5413-5422` ("the smoke-test prefix is not guaranteed to survive that rewrite").
  Expected change site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` `tracking_issue_is_smoke_fixture` (lines ~646-660) — needs a body/marker signal that survives the LLM `project_title` rewrite. Concretely one of: (a) have the gate also apply the `e2e-smoke-test` label to the orchestrator decompose tracking issue (gated on the same dispatch that creates the orchestrator run); (b) accept a body-content marker such as `e2e orchestrate smoke` in the tracking-issue body (the gate embeds `${GITHUB_RUN_ID}` in `PROJECT_DESC` and the orchestrator's `build_tracking_body` projects the description into `project_summary`, which is included in the tracking body); or (c) read the `integration branch` body footer the orchestrator writes (already propagated) and match the `orchestrator/project-<RUN_ID>` shape against the `MARKER="E2E Orchestrate Smoke ${RUN_ID}"` set in the gate.
  Evidence of absence: LAST RUN DIFF only adjusted the existing title patterns; PR DIFF introduces `tracking_issue_is_smoke_fixture` which inspects `title` and `labels_json` only (no body argument is passed at the call sites at lines 19931-19944, and no new `e2e-smoke-test` label is applied to the orchestrator's tracking issue anywhere in `test-and-mark-stable.yml` or `orchestrate.yml` — confirmed by the grep showing `e2e-smoke-test` only on PR-side / concurrency / job-name contexts). The test `test_poller_does_not_treat_real_projects_as_smoke` exercises the bracketed and unbracketed `E2E Orchestrate Smoke` title forms but never the unprefixed title (`[Orchestrator] Update two smoke canary files in parallel`) the gate itself acknowledges is the unfixed case. `tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:402-414` — no assertion covers the prefix-dropped decompose fixture case.

  PROBLEM: The detector recognizes the decomposed smoke project only when its generated title starts with `E2E Orchestrate Smoke`.
  WHY: The smoke workflow says the decomposer derives the tracking title from the project description and that the description’s smoke prefix is “not guaranteed to survive that rewrite” (`.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5414-5421`). The orchestrator creates the tracking issue with `ai:orchestrator-tracking`, but does not add the `e2e-smoke-test` label (`.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1085-1095`). If the decomposer omits or changes the marker, this project is absent from `SMOKE_FIXTURE_TRACKING_NUMS`, so its poller alerts are sent.
